visuals.purpose: Contextualize Dhaka’s informal work environments and residential conditions during periods of extreme heat, highlighting lived experience and the visible reality of adaptation pressures.
visuals.truth_boundary: Visual should represent conditions and adaptation efforts seen in Dhaka informal settings, not quantify losses or extend survey findings to unsampled groups.

visuals.purpose: Show trustworthy, study-specific data of heat season length and cooling payback from the referenced factory study, providing a tight visual narrative link to the site-specific economic evidence.
visuals.truth_boundary: Graphic must display only the measured payback periods and heat-season distribution for the studied garment factories, labeling these as site-specific; may not generalize to all factories.

visuals.purpose: Situate physically the contrast between well-cooled factories/households and those lacking protection in Dhaka, conveying the material and social divide in adaptation, not measured economic figures.
visuals.truth_boundary: Visual should illustrate real, contrasting access to cooling but must not display inferred statistics or staged comparisons.

output.routing_note: Still-image generation is used only for contextual representation; quantitative claims route to deterministic graphics. Provider availability may change fulfilment method but not scene meaning or evidence.
